transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello — do you have any questions about your cataract surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. First, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You can go back to light exercise after 1 week, and that includes gardening. Just avoid heavy work or straining for 1 month. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you for that information. I also wanted to ask, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: If you were using eye drops before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it’s safe to continue using them unless you’ve been told otherwise. If you’re running out, your GP should be able to provide more. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: That's helpful, thanks. Another question I have is, I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: A bit of light sensitivity can be normal as your eyes adjust to the new lenses. If it’s mild and things just seem brighter, sunglasses outside can help. But if it’s severe, or you have pain, redness, or a very painful red eye, it’s not normal and may need to be checked. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thanks for clarifying that. I have one more question: should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Yes, it’s common for vision not to be completely clear in the first week after the operation. It should improve quickly and settle down over time. If it’s still blurry, or getting worse, it may need to be checked. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, I think that covers everything I wanted to ask. Thank you for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have all your questions been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, all my questions have been answered. Thank you very much for your assistance!

verdict.label: pass

It also conveyed `mild_case_advice` with, "If it’s mild and things just seem brighter, sunglasses outside can help." Finally, `escalation_criteria` was covered by, "But if it’s severe, or you have pain, redness, or a very painful red eye, it’s not normal and may need to be checked." All points were covered in a single turn.
